summary: Frontend-only verification run completed with strict no-write policy. AI Tour regression suite passed (5/5), new isolated customer-verification suite passed (2/2), and scoped lint passed on all touched modules. Full live-modal UI coverage remains blocked in preview because no active Live Tour fixture exposed `aitour-live-verify` under read-only constraints.

ui_bugs.issue: `aitour-live-verify` was not present during mobile web session, so VerificationRequestModal could not be opened from the real LiveTourView flow in this environment.
No discoverable `data-testid` elements were exposed on splash/auth surface in this run, reducing deterministic automation reliability for protected flows.

integration_issues.flow: Live tour -> Manda in verifica -> modal submit
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute end-to-end modal interaction in production preview without an active next-stop live fixture while preserving no-write rule.

issues: Repeated non-blocking warning: deprecated `shadow*` style props on web logs.

action_items: Provide a non-mutating LiveTourView harness/fixture (outside production routes) exposing `aitour-live-verify` so modal flow can be fully automated without touching real tours.
Add stable `testID` attributes on splash/auth critical controls for deterministic mobile-web automation.
After fixture availability, rerun modal checks covering radio options, review-confirm, error-retry, and success banner messaging with POST `customer_verification_requests` browser-mocked.
critical_code_review_comments: `customer-verification.ts` idempotency and actor checks behaved correctly in isolated tests (preflight select, stable UUID retry, no insert on actor mismatch).
`useVerificationRequest.ts` draft-first then remote-write guard validated indirectly by isolated service/location tests; no functional defect surfaced in this run.
No backend/FastAPI changes detected for this feature scope; verification behavior is frontend+Supabase client path.

success_rate.frontend: Regression/unit/lint executed: 100% pass on executed automated suites; Live modal E2E coverage blocked by missing active fixture

seed_data_creation: None. No real Supabase INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/RPC mutating operations executed.

Mitigation: mount an isolated LiveTourView harness with fixture state and intercepted network writes, then rerun full modal interaction assertions.
